That works out to a volume of about 100 to 150 ml. Scrambled egg is fluffy, so I'll take it as roughly 0.7 g/ml, which gives about 80 to 100 g. That is around 2 eggs' worth.

Scrambled egg with a little butter is about 1.5 kcal/g, so 90 g comes to roughly 135 kcal. I'll round up slightly to allow for cooking fat.
